title: Medtrum Nano - on connection loss while bolusing, carbs are not recorded, but insulin is in full amount
symptom: Using Medtrum Nano, giving bolus from the calculator, every once in a while I get a connection loss (probably around every 10th bolus). The problem is, that the carbs from the calculator are only recorded at the end of the successful bolus, meaning they are not recorded on connection loss... although the insulin is recorded in full amount.
cause: Carbs are recorded only on successful bolus. It's by design and it's a safety feature to prevent double carb entry if bolus fails and user re-enters carbs.
fix: No fix provided; maintainer explains it's by design. The notification text was noted to be amended to mention that carbs were not recorded, but no change is stated.
evidence_quote: Easy. If bolus fail and carbs are recorded and user enter the carbs again in wizard it will get bolus acording to double amount of carbs
